description: `DIRECTIVE_COMMENT_RE` in hooks/lib/comment_rules.py still carries the old alternative `#\s*eslint-disable(?:-\w+)*\b`. It exempts `# eslint-disable <any prose>` in every file type, so an agent can hide a prose comment behind it. `#` is not a JavaScript comment, so the alternative has no legitimate use in JS or TS. Remove it or anchor it to an exact shape, and add a test that prose after the prefix gets a finding. Found by the T-012 agent on 2026-10-05.
title: Close the loose hash eslint-disable directive escape
